title: For engineers & builders
problem: You keep meeting the same failure modes — the late project, the creeping complexity, the metric that gets gamed. They already have names.
blurb: The laws you learn the hard way, gathered in one place. Ship dates, systems that grow to fit their org chart, quirks that become contracts — the patterns every engineer eventually runs into, explained and sourced.

title: For product & decision-makers
problem: Every call you make runs on incomplete information and a mind full of shortcuts. Knowing the shortcuts by name is how you stop them steering you.
blurb: The traps that bend judgement — targets that get gamed, plans that always run long, the sunk cost you can't walk away from — and the biases that skew a decision before you've made it. Learn the shape, catch yourself mid-mistake.

title: For writers & communicators
problem: Getting an idea from your head into someone else's is a fight against noise, refutation, and the curse of already knowing the answer.
blurb: The laws of attention, clarity, and persuasion — why most of everything is mediocre, why a headline that asks a question can be answered “no”, and why the fastest way to a right answer is to post a wrong one. Tools for anyone who writes to be read.

title: For leaders & managers
problem: Organisations have their own physics. People rise to where they stall, work expands to fill the calendar, and the structure you build quietly shapes what you can build.
blurb: The laws of organisations and incentives — competence promoted past its limit, bureaucracies that grow whatever you do, and the diffusion of responsibility that leaves everyone waiting on everyone else. For anyone trying to get a group to do good work.

title: For curious minds
problem: You want sharper tools for thinking — ways to weigh a claim, remember what you read, and notice when your own mind is fooling you.
blurb: Razors for cutting through nonsense, the effects that shape what you remember, and the biases that quietly distort what you believe. A starter kit for thinking more clearly about everything else.
